_meta.about: Every string of the macOS menu bar app and the Windows and Linux tray app. English text first, then vi, zh, fr and pt (pt is Brazilian Portuguese). {name} style placeholders are filled by the app. The app picks the language from the system and falls back to en. Wording follows the manage page (web/manage/src/i18n).
_meta.plural: menu.phones.none / .one / .other: pick by count (0, 1, anything else). The other keys have no plural forms.
